title: Font/image/import sanitization regression hardening
outcome: User-uploaded fonts and images are validated before entering the library or the renderer: the font registry and image sniffing paths reject hostile or malformed inputs with typed errors, proven by a regression suite, with no change to valid-file behavior.
before: GOVERNOR.md Security Rules require defensive sanitization of fonts/images; the truth ledger lists the font registry as proven for valid uploads, but no negative-input regression suite exists for font or image parsing paths (src/engine/font-registry.ts, src/engine/sniff.ts). Follows the import-fuzz corpus work so parser-level findings can inform validation coverage.
after: A negative-input regression suite covers font upload, image sniffing and placement paths; hostile inputs are rejected with typed errors; valid fonts/images continue to register and render identically.
acceptance: Malformed font files (truncated, wrong magic, hostile name tables) are rejected with typed errors, never corrupting the registry state.
Malformed/lying-mime images are rejected or safely sniffed per existing sniff.ts policy.
Valid font and image flows unchanged: existing font-registry and image tests green.
npx tsc --noEmit, targeted tests and npm run build pass.

builder.notes: Builder zcode-sanitize-pc1 (pc-cloud1), branch agent/viro-0014/zcode-gov-audit-pc1 based on post-wave-merge main 72b05f0 (worktree rebased from 9f0ed70; inherited banked prep drafts verified 5/5 in before-state mode on the new base first). Before-state re-confirmed: loadFace (HarfBuzz WASM) accepts text bytes, empty buffers and a 50%-truncated real TTF; FontRegistry.importBytes persisted hostile bytes to IndexedDB and prettyFamily retained path separators/NULs from hostile filenames; sniffBytes trusted extension fallbacks so text named .ttf reached the font importer. Fixes, all inside the lease: (1) src/engine/font-registry.ts — exported validateFontBytes enforcing zero-byte, 20 MiB cap, container magic (sfnt/OTTO/true/ttcf/wOFF/wOF2), 64-byte minimum and sfnt table-directory bounds before loadFace; typed FontImportError {code: too-small|bad-magic|too-large|undecodable} wraps loadFace with cause; importBytes sanitizes filenames (path separators, control bytes, 120-char cap) before prettyFamily; persistence stays strictly after successful decode; the same validator now guards loadBundled (tripwire), loadUserFonts (rows persisted pre-hardening) and ensureLoaded (system-picker bytes). (2) src/engine/sniff.ts — SniffedFile gains magic field; image/font kinds are now produced only by a real magic match, so extension lies (text named .ttf/.png) classify unknown and cannot reach importFontBytes/placeImage through ingestFiles' existing call site; exported validateImageBytes enforces empty/25 MiB cap/wrong-magic/truncated/bad-dimensions (PNG IHDR, GIF screen descriptor, BMP core/info headers, WEBP RIFF payload, JPEG SOF walk) with typed ImageImportError; DOM decode stays browser-side. (3) tests/import-sanitize-corpus.mjs corpusVersion 2 (hardened classifications for six extension-lie/zero-byte entries, per-case expectCode/imageCode, hostile BMP generator corrected to spec little-endian header fields; fonts digest 9bde3d2fe3abbdccff1cc34d8fb1a02a63d2cb047a59f7d38ba283345ab3e54f, images digest 5790b9f31d6f8223a580972e38a7e140948af64f6899c98f587e1808b79a2b63) and tests/import-sanitize.test.mjs flipped to hardened MODE with per-case typed-code assertions. Known honest record: validateImageBytes is exported and unit-proven but app.ts (outside this lease) does not yet call it before placeImage decode; the wired image hardening on this base is the sniffBytes lie refusal. Valid-file behavior unchanged: real NotoSans TTF still imports with family 'NotoSans' through the new boundary.
proof: node --experimental-strip-types --import ./tests/ts-register.mjs --test tests/import-sanitize.test.mjs: 5/5 pass in hardened mode, run twice (deterministic)
Before-state proof on new base before implementing: same suite in before-state MODE 5/5 pass with hardened test skipped (hostile acceptance documented, positive control green)
npm run test:unit: 316/316 pass (fixed list; text-model and font-registry consumers unaffected)

critic.notes: Engine validation hardening; no UI change.

delta.after: Negative-input regression suite with typed rejections at the font registry and sniff boundaries; valid flows byte-identical.
